Hi Vanessa / Monica,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. We’re finalizing the sponsorship details for our September newsletter blast (Pressly Weekly) and wanted to confirm a couple of items so we can lock creative: 

- Promo codes: We typically give our readers a trial package and would like to distribute ~500 unique codes to start (audience: 180k subscribers, but we expect a 0.3–0.6% activation). Can Redwood provide a batch of unique trial access codes we can drop into the HTML?
- Trial length: Can Redwood extend the default 14-day trial to 30 days for Pressly-sourced activations? Marketing will call this a “Pressly 30-day trial” and it matters for uptake.
- Timing: Our send is scheduled for Tue, 7 Sep. We need code delivery and a short T&Cs doc by Fri, 3 Sep.

Attached is a short demand estimate (pressly_demand_estimate.xlsx) with expected regional splits. For procurement, CC’d procurement@presslymedia.com — they’ll need invoice timing and any contract addendum.

Let us know feasibility and any ops constraints.

Best,
Anna Lee
Partnerships, Pressly Media

Marissa / Vanessa — quick ops confirmation: 

- Capacity: Landing page with promo-code redemption at the anticipated activation volume (projected peak ~400/day if the open rate spikes) is fine. We recommend rate-limiting redemption endpoints to 10 rps burst with autoscaling; this has been tested for similar newsletter campaigns.
- Attribution: We will include campaign_tag=pressly_weekly and source=pressly_newsletter in the code metadata so analytics can be segmented.
- Token allowances: These are standard 30-day trials; we’ll apply the promo quantization profile and disable free tokens beyond the 30 days. Retention rules will follow default account policies.
- Delivery: I’ll upload code_pool.csv (350 codes) to the shared drive link and mark the first 200 as active. Please do not publish the reserve codes.
